name: Samir Akhalil
title: M.Sc. Engineering Student | AI & Machine Learning
intro: Building intelligent systems and solving real-world problems through software engineering and artificial intelligence.
about: I'm an M.Sc. Engineering student in AI and Machine Learning at Blekinge Institute of Technology, graduating in 2027. I have hands-on experience applying AI and machine learning to real data from industry and public agencies.

Right now I'm part of a student team building an AI agent for Trafikverket that triages production alerts, running on self-hosted language models so that no operational data leaves the organisation's network. I also work on classifying building and energy sensors from more than 7.5 million time-series measurements at Axiogreen.
I'm looking for a master's thesis in AI for spring 2027.
